evidence.reason: The strongest controls implemented an always-A policy and no control beat the best constant answer-position policy. The nominal accuracy therefore does not demonstrate that the solver read the mathematical state or alternatives.

highest_ev_next_action: Build a new versioned acquisition instrument with a demonstrated positive mathematical-reading control and a relation-destroyed negative control, then recalibrate without reusing these responses.
uncertainty: This invalidates this model/task interface; it does not show that all representations or all solvers have no fitness landscape.
